_doc: 1 Slice 1 — the engine/gamesystem scope map for the ESLint boundary fence. Paths are prefixes relative to apps/web/src/app (a trailing '/' = folder prefix; no trailing slash = exact file, extension omitted). Only UNAMBIGUOUS, high/medium-confidence scopes are listed — the shared engine substrate (mission/, resolve*, aar/, new-campaign-state, clock/, barracks/, battle/{force,damage,reconcile}) and every Appendix-D ambiguity are DELIBERATELY OMITTED so they are unscoped (fence-exempt) pending decision D-0..D-6 in BOUNDARY-MAP.md. See BOUNDARY-MAP.md §4. HSFORGE-1 ruling D3 (2026-07-16): contract/faction-matchup.ts RETAGGED engine-classic → unscoped — pure both-engines universe-plausibility logic (zero mode branches, header says it lifts to apps/api) = platform by the D-0 sort; its only consumer was Traditional's market, but the HS Forge now calls it too. No enforcement removed (no fenced edge used it) and none added. engine-odm = campaign/odm/ (the ruled fork container). Its Class-2 SHARED mounts (walk/inventory/repair/market-adjacent Classic UI) appear as engine-odm->engine-classic edges in the baseline — the RULED shared-platform consumption, recorded as odm's clean-start baseline; engine-odm->engine-hs must stay ZERO.
